name: Yeguozi
summary: Curated film stills for home color and interiors, browsable by color, space, object, director and collection.
description: A personal editorial project collecting film stills that are strong in color, light, space and home. Films are grouped into colors, interior spaces, furnishings and photographic-aesthetics sections, with palette summaries, space/object tags and frame notes; curated collections such as The Rohmer Way (9 films, 515 stills) group them by mood. Published in Chinese, English and Japanese.
contains: browse by color (red, green, blue), space (living room, bedroom, kitchen), object, photography
collections such as The Rohmer Way: 9 films, 515 stills
director and cinematographer indexes with film counts (Wes Anderson 4, Éric Rohmer 10, Pedro Almodóvar 5)
film pages carry bilingual titles, palette summaries and frame notes
